notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler and Workhorse each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse and Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
